# Daron Namibia

> Daron Namibia (legal name Daron Trading Namibia (Pty) Ltd; formerly Walvis Bay Ship Chandlers / WBSC, founded 2012) is a ship chandler and marine and industrial supplier in Walvis Bay, Namibia, and part of the Daron Group. Namibian distributor for Hempel marine and protective coatings and Orlichem marine and industrial chemicals; supplier of Hammelmann high-pressure water-jetting equipment, Honeywell, Blackline Safety and Industrial Scientific gas detection, and Katradis mooring ropes.

Walvis Bay Ship Chandlers (WBSC, wbsc.com.na) and Daron Namibia are the same company. Older listings may show WBSC details; the contact details below are current.

- Address: No. 31 Grand Avenue, Industrial Area, Walvis Bay 13013, Erongo Region, Namibia
- Ports served: Walvis Bay and Lüderitz
- Phone: +264 83 337 4710
- Email: dnoperations@daron-group.com (operations), namtechnical@daron-group.com (technical)
- Hours: Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00 CAT; offshore RFQs handled 24/7 on WhatsApp
- Managing Director: Luther Mostert
- Certifications and memberships: ISO 9001:2015, HACCP; ISSA member, IMPA listed

## Services
- [Ship chandlery in Walvis Bay](https://www.daron.com.na/services/ship-chandlery): provisions, bonded, deck, engine and cabin stores, safety equipment and technical spares, delivered quayside, at anchorage and offshore
- [Vessel provisions](https://www.daron.com.na/services/vessel-provisions): fresh, chilled, frozen and dry provisions and bonded stores in Walvis Bay and Lüderitz
- [Marine paint in Namibia](https://www.daron.com.na/services/marine-paint): Hempel antifouling, anticorrosive, tank linings and fire protection
- [Industrial cleaning chemicals in Namibia](https://www.daron.com.na/services/industrial-cleaning-chemicals): Orlichem degreasers, CIP, marine, galley and laundry chemicals
- [Coatings](https://www.daron.com.na/services/coatings): Hempel marine and protective coatings
- [Dry-dock support](https://www.daron.com.na/services/dry-dock): technical support for vessels in dry dock
- [Oil and gas](https://www.daron.com.na/industries/oil-and-gas): offshore rig and FPSO supply
